raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Customers migrated to the new CRM carry numeric region codes ('01'-'04') instead of region names, so silver_customers has invalid region values and gold_region_daily splits revenue across codes. raw_region_map provides an authoritative one-to-one code-to-name mapping (01=WEST, 02=EAST, 03=NORTH, 04=SOUTH), so the codes can be translated deterministically.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.88, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_customers": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_customers AS SELECT c.customer_id, upper(COALESCE(m.region_name, c.region)) AS region FROM raw_customers c LEFT JOIN raw_region_map m ON c.region = m.region_code"}}
